prompt_issues.description: Enforcement bluff: the prompt threatens numeric-provenance verification and the challenger asserts code-side hallucination counting, but no numeric-provenance checker appears in the provided code, and the challenger's own input view is character-capped so it cannot faithfully verify. Unenforced threats decay compliance and create a false audit trail. (Whether a provenance checker exists elsewhere is unverified from this excerpt.)
prompt_issues.evidence: 证伪官会逐条核验数字出处, 来源不明数字会被记为幻觉 (USER_TEMPLATE 论据溯源) / 幻觉计数由代码独立核验 (CHALLENGER)
prompt_issues.fix: Implement a real checker (extract numerals from thesis/evidence/tripwires, match against data_text, persist hallucination_count per decision) or delete the claim from both prompts.

prompt_issues.description: The edge test's sample window is premarket-only and explicitly ignores news age, so it mistakes staleness, absence, and prior-session reflection for edge: (a) news from the prior session that already moved the stock intraday counts as 'not reflected' if premarket is flat — prior-day close-to-close reflection is not in the test; (b) a missing ⚡盘前时段 section defaults to 'no movement' → edge granted; (c) stale-but-unpriced news earns edge credit toward HIGH.
prompt_issues.evidence: 判定依据不是新闻的"年龄"，而是**该信息是否已被价格反映**。判断材料 = 盘前异动 (盘前涨跌幅/盘前成交量 ...) · 若信息尚未被反映(盘前无异动/量能不支撑)且可溯源核实 → 这是真 edge 来源
prompt_issues.fix: HIGH requires a joint condition: event age ≤48h AND not reflected in prior-session move AND not reflected premarket; if the premarket section is absent, cap score_band at MEDIUM.

prompt_issues.description: HIGH criterion ① depends on self-labeled claim_type: the model both writes the claim and assigns its type, so it can tag a weak news-derived claim as product_catalyst/earnings_beat to satisfy the band criterion. A code-side classifier exists (signal_gate._infer_claim_type reusing ic_writer._classify_claim) but no shown path cross-checks the analyst's self-labels against it.
prompt_issues.evidence: ①bull/bear_case中至少1条claim_type为product_catalyst或earnings_beat(公司独有事件) ... bull_case/bear_case的每条必须标注claim_type，从以下枚举中选择最匹配的
prompt_issues.fix: Cross-check self-labels against the code classifier at gate time; mismatch → band downgrade or flag; persist mismatch counts per decision.

prompt_issues.description: Criterion ② notation is ambiguous ('盘前同向异动|涨跌幅|<2%' — pipes as separators, undefined missing-data branch) and defaults to pass when premarket data is absent. Criterion ③'s sufficiency header is computed by the system from collection results, but nothing shown indicates it accounts for freshness — a stale-but-present dimension (e.g. the 93-day sentiment cache) can satisfy '充分 ✓' (hypothesis: header computation not in excerpt, needs verification).
prompt_issues.evidence: ②核心信息未被价格反映(盘前同向异动|涨跌幅|<2%, 或盘前成交量未见放量, 以⚡盘前时段数据段为准 ...) ③数据头部标记"数据充分性: 充分 ✓"
prompt_issues.fix: Rewrite ② as explicit boolean logic with a defined missing-data branch (missing → criterion fails); include max section age and non-null value checks in the sufficiency computation.

prompt_issues.description: PE=0 rule conflates a missing-data sentinel with unprofitability. This exact rule plus a key mismatch historically injected a false 'loss-making company' bear argument into 100% of analyses (documented in _fundamental_view docstring); the key fix landed, but the rule still fires on any 0-sentinel from degraded paths.
prompt_issues.evidence: 如果PE为负或0，说明该股亏损或无盈利，必须在bear_case中提及 — _fundamental_view docstring: 每只股票被强制注入一条虚假"亏损公司"看空论据
prompt_issues.fix: Apply only when PE is present and < 0; treat 0/None as 'missing' routed to data_quality_note/evidence_gaps.

prompt_issues.description: The contract advertises enforcement that is switched off: invalidation_triggers are framed as machine-cancellable while tripwire_checker runs shadow-only. The prompt's threat model is partially fictional; models obey unenforced rules less reliably and the audit trail overstates safety.
prompt_issues.evidence: 当前下游 tripwire_checker 仅做影子评估, `tripwire_checker_enforce=false` 时不修改指令
prompt_issues.fix: Enable enforcement for the narrow enum-constrained invalidation_triggers (they were designed for exactly that) or reword all references to 'shadow observation only'.

prompt_issues.description: The falsifier shares the analyst's blind spots: same data view, same staleness, same absence/failure ambiguity. It can catch internal inconsistency (numbers not in data, broken causality) but not data-level errors — stale sentiment, failed fetches rendered as 'no news', missing short interest. None of its five validation dimensions challenges data adequacy or freshness, so 'falsification' cannot falsify data-driven theses whose data is wrong.
prompt_issues.evidence: 你的任务不是"独立复现分析"(实测107/107与分析师同向=伪独立, 同一份证据第二次阅读必然趋同), 而是**主动证伪当前候选方向** ... 原始数据: {_challenger_data_view(data_text)}
prompt_issues.fix: Add a sixth validation dimension — data adequacy/freshness ('would this direction survive if the stale/absent sections were wrong?'), and feed the challenger the same freshness/failure audit the analyst should see.

prompt_issues.description: Challenger input is character-capped: the view builder immediately preceding _run_challenger truncates at _cap. Numbers the analyst cited from beyond the cap get falsely flagged '来源不明数字' (false hallucination), and counter-evidence beyond the cap is invisible → wrongful AGREE. Which view (data vs analysis) is capped needs confirmation, but the truncation pattern is verified in code.
prompt_issues.fix: Section-aware truncation (drop whole low-priority sections, never mid-section) or full parity with the analyst's data_text; log truncation ratio per call.

prompt_issues.description: Synthetic ACME example anchors argument shapes even though reuse is banned. The example bear arguments (insider zero-buys, retail crowding) become attractors: when those dimensions are stale or missing, the model may emit lookalike claims with real numbers borrowed from elsewhere, satisfying the letter of the ban. The guard depends on the unverified hallucination check.
prompt_issues.evidence: 以下用合成示例股 ACME(虚构公司, 数字为占位符)展示论据质量水准——禁止复用示例中的任何具体数字/事件到你的真实输出 ... 高管近3个月零买入、套现约$V ... 散户情绪一边倒看多约U%偏拥挤
prompt_issues.fix: Replace examples with a field-level rubric (required elements per claim), or keep examples but machine-flag outputs whose claim_type distribution mirrors the example set when the corresponding data sections are absent.

prompt_issues.description: Stop-loss dictation turns risk analysis into compliance: the model is told the acceptable band upfront, so the emitted stop is not asset-specific analysis — downstream consumers cannot distinguish analyzed stops from dictated ones (precision theater).
prompt_issues.evidence: 止损钳制: 你给出的止损距离会被执行层按波动桶钳制到合理边界(约1.5-5.8% ...) 直接给 2-5% 区间内的止损即可; 小于2%易落入噪声扫损区
prompt_issues.fix: Require an ATR/volatility-justified stop with a rationale field; let the execution clamp adjust and record both raw and clamped values for audit.

prompt_issues.description: Debate quota asymmetry: the winning side needs ≥2 claims, the opposing side may be 0. Honest by design, but combined with decisiveness pressure the output structurally under-weights counter-evidence; the challenger is the only counterweight and shares the same data blind spots.
prompt_issues.evidence: bull_case+bear_case 合计 2-6 条, 最终方向一侧至少 2 条, 反方允许 0 条 ... 数据支持看空就坚定给SELL_SHORT，不必强凑看多论据
prompt_issues.fix: Require the losing side to be either non-empty or explicitly declared ('反方论据: 无 — 输入数据中未发现可溯源反证') so emptiness is a judgment, not a default.

prompt_issues.description: Several 'machine-checkable' fields are only presence-checkable and thus gameable: causal_chain (count arrows), tripwires (fill metric/threshold/deadline triples with plausible numbers), data_quality_note (copy the audit numbers verbatim). The number-anchor rule is satisfiable by pasting any input number into a generic thesis — presence, not semantic linkage, is what gets checked.
prompt_issues.evidence: causal_chain: "3步以上因果传导链(用→连接)" / tripwires必须≥2条且全部可量化观测 / data_quality_note必须量化：直接照抄数据中"数据质量审计"段的数字
prompt_issues.fix: Add cheap semantic validators (arrow-chain must reference ≥2 distinct input entities; tripwire thresholds must appear in or derive from input) plus a sampled human audit of ~20 outputs/week.

prompt_issues.description: Anchoring and adversarial priming contaminate the 'independent' direction: the candidate direction is revealed in the header and step 1 instructs 'assume it loses' BEFORE independent_direction is recorded — the anti-anchoring observation metric is itself anchored toward the opposite direction.
prompt_issues.evidence: 【证伪任务 — 第14轮 P9】候选方向 = {initial_analysis.get('direction','?')}。第一步【假设它错了】: 仅根据以下原始数据, 假设 ... 方向会亏损 ... 把你在"不看分析师结论"下独立倾向的方向填入 independent_direction
prompt_issues.fix: Reorder: elicit independent_direction from raw data alone (candidate direction withheld) first, then reveal the candidate and run the falsification pass.

prompt_issues.description: Verdict rules are ambiguous for exactly one counter-evidence: rule 3 says '找不到≥2条 → AGREE' (literally true when exactly 1 is found) while rule 2 says '找到反证但不足以推翻 → PARTIAL_AGREE'. The 1-counter-evidence case is undefined; models will resolve it inconsistently, degrading verdict comparability.
prompt_issues.evidence: 找到了≥2条有数据出处的具体反证, 且足以推翻方向 → DISAGREE / 找到反证但不足以推翻方向(只够降低确信度) → PARTIAL_AGREE / 找不到≥2条有出处的具体反证 → AGREE
prompt_issues.fix: 0 counter-evidences → AGREE; ≥1 but insufficient to overturn → PARTIAL_AGREE; DISAGREE requires sufficiency, not count.

prompt_issues.description: Temperature unification removed debate diversity: analyst (was 0.3) and challenger (was 0.4) now both run at 0.0, so challenger 'independence' rests solely on base-model difference; and the challenger was downgraded pro→flash with only format compliance validated, not detection power.
prompt_issues.evidence: LLM_TEMPERATURE = float(_read_env("DA_LLM_TEMPERATURE") or "0.0") / DA 挑战者 deepseek-v4-pro-0813 → deepseek-v4.1-flash ... 契约 12 键全在
prompt_issues.fix: Shadow A/B the challenger (flash vs pro, temp 0 vs 0.4) on historical decisions measuring DISAGREE hit rate against realized outcomes before accepting the downgrade.

prompt_issues.description: The knife-geometry consistency rule is documented LONG-only; the mirror case (SELL_SHORT into a >+5% premarket spike with cap semantics) has no analogous prompt guidance. Hypothesis: the execution layer may handle the mirror case, but it is not stated — needs verification.
prompt_issues.evidence: 当盘前涨跌 < -5% 且你仍给 LONG: ① chase_cap_price 必须 ≥ 昨收×0.95 ... (no symmetric SHORT-on-spike clause)
prompt_issues.fix: Add the mirrored geometric constraint for SHORT on large premarket up-moves, or document that the execution layer handles it symmetrically.

source_chain_issues.description: curl is invoked without -f and HTTP status is never checked; a Finnhub 403/429 JSON body {"error": ...} parses successfully, passes the collectors' `if "_error" in data` guard (key is 'error', not '_error'), and surfaces as an all-None metric dict — silent, unlabeled dimension loss that looks like normal sparsity. Separately, genuine {"_error": ...} dicts are returned as-is by collectors; whether the prompt renderer filters the _error key is not shown — risk it renders as if data.
source_chain_issues.fix: Capture HTTP status (curl -w '%{http_code}' or -f), map Finnhub 'error' bodies to _error, filter _error keys at the renderer, and count failed dimensions into the 数据质量审计 header.

source_chain_issues.description: Non-zero API code returns [] — fetch failure is indistinguishable from 'no news'. The prompt then renders an absent news dimension; the model reads absence as 'no catalysts' (absence-vs-failure ambiguity). No fetch timestamp is attached.
source_chain_issues.fix: Return {"_error": code} on non-zero; renderer prints '采集失败(原因)' vs '无数据' distinctly with as-of time.

mislead_risks.risk: 3-month-old cache presented without fetch date → model treats stale crowding as current

mislead_risks.risk: fetch failure rendered as 'no news' — absence vs failure ambiguity

mislead_risks.fix: Label units at render time; normalize to one unit in the presentation layer (as _fundamental_view already did for keys).

mislead_risks.risk: Chinese-only enum matching undercounts English outputs; mixed-language thresholds lack a unit schema
mislead_risks.concrete_scenario: Model (zh prompt, en data) outputs metric 'close price'; pipeline's counter str(_t.get("metric") or "") in ("收盘价","量比","5日涨跌","盘前涨跌幅") records 0 triggers → decision looks non-compliant in audit though semantically valid; tripwire thresholds like '低于$5B' mix currency and magnitude.
mislead_risks.fix: Bilingual enum normalization before counting; typed threshold schema (value + unit).

mislead_risks.location: calibration stats embedded in prompt text
mislead_risks.risk: frozen historical stats cited as current evidence; with feedback DBs verified empty they can never be re-validated (survivorship of the prompt's own history)
mislead_risks.concrete_scenario: Prompt cites '实证 9/14: HPE 昨收62.09/禁追58.00' and challenger cites '107/107' — measured under old designs; because signals.db/alpha.db are empty, no new sample can confirm or retire these claims; a stat that stopped being true persists in the instruction indefinitely.
mislead_risks.fix: Move measured stats to a data-injected block with as-of date and sample size, regenerated from the revived feedback DB.

mislead_risks.risk: sufficiency computed from presence, not freshness or non-nullness (hypothesis — computation not shown)
mislead_risks.concrete_scenario: All dimensions 'collected' (including the 93-day sentiment cache and a 403-degraded fundamentals dict with keys present but values None) → header reads '数据充分性: 充分 ✓' → HIGH criterion ③ passes on stale/degraded data.
mislead_risks.fix: Sufficiency requires non-null values + age below TTL; degraded/failed counts feed the header.

mislead_risks.risk: monthly recommendation snapshot rendered without age
mislead_risks.concrete_scenario: Finnhub recommendation latest period is 5 weeks old (period present, no age computed); the rule '如果提供了analyst_consensus数据...必须在bull/bear_case中引用买入占比和分析师数量' forces quoting stale consensus as current — passes provenance yet misleads.
mislead_risks.fix: Render period + age; rule applies only when period is within N weeks.

top_3_actions: Fix failure/staleness semantics end-to-end: fetch timestamps + per-section age labels, TTL-guard the 93-day sentiment cache, curl HTTP-status + Finnhub error-body → _error, and render '采集失败' vs '无数据' distinctly (S effort, removes the highest-density mislead channels).

Revive or excise the verified-dead feedback loop (signals.db 0 tables, alpha.db 0 tables, strategy_memory.db 0 bytes since 2026-08-04): the system has run 15,131 LLM calls open-loop while prompts and the signal gate still cite experience, claim-IC and measured stats.

Restore challenger data parity (remove [:_cap] truncation, independent-direction-first ordering) and implement the real numeric-provenance checker + claim_type cross-check that the prompts already claim exists.
overall_assessment.summary: The prompt layer is unusually self-critical and above industry norm: explicit long/short symmetry ('多空对称适用...不是历史胜率偏见'), honest-empty rules ('留空是诚实输出'), enum-constrained machine-checkable triggers, prompt fingerprinting and baseline-splitting hygiene. Its real defects are (a) enforcement claims that outrun the code — numeric-provenance 'hallucination counting' is asserted but no checker is shown, tripwire enforcement is shadow-only, the challenger's input is character-capped, and HIGH criterion ① is self-certifiable via self-labeled claim_type; and (b) an edge-calibration test whose premarket-only window mistakes staleness, absence, and prior-session reflection for genuine edge. The source chain is the weaker half and where capital risk actually lives: verified measurements show the entire feedback loop is dead (signals.db, alpha.db, strategy_memory.db all empty) while the gate and prompts still reference experience and claim-IC; the sentiment cache is 3 months stale (36 rows, last fetch 2026-07-10); Futu news failures return [] indistinguishable from 'no news'; and curl-without-status lets Finnhub 403/429 bodies parse as data, silently emptying fundamentals. Net: a sophisticated open-loop system. Fix failure/staleness semantics and the feedback loop before further prompt tuning. Caveats: the prompt renderer's _error filtering, the sufficiency-header computation, the sentiment-cache serving path, and whether a provenance checker exists elsewhere are not in the provided excerpt and need code confirmation; freshness figures are verified measurements, all such gaps are flagged as hypotheses above.
